CREATE TABLE context_retirement_preservations (
 operation_ulid TEXT CHECK(operation_ulid IS NULL OR (typeof(operation_ulid)='text' AND length(operation_ulid)=26 AND substr(operation_ulid,1,1) BETWEEN '0' AND '7' AND operation_ulid NOT GLOB '*[^0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ]*')) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES context_retirement_records(operation_ulid) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 abandon_request_ulid TEXT CHECK(abandon_request_ulid IS NULL OR (typeof(abandon_request_ulid)='text' AND length(abandon_request_ulid)=26 AND substr(abandon_request_ulid,1,1) BETWEEN '0' AND '7' AND abandon_request_ulid NOT GLOB '*[^0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ]*')) NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES request_records(request_ulid) ON DELETE NO ACTION,
 accepted_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(accepted_attempt)='integer' AND accepted_attempt>0),
 owner_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(owner_epoch)='integer' AND owner_epoch>0),
 snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot))
)

CREATE TABLE context_retirement_preservation_claims (
 operation_ulid TEXT CHECK(operation_ulid IS NULL OR (typeof(operation_ulid)='text' AND length(operation_ulid)=26 AND substr(operation_ulid,1,1) BETWEEN '0' AND '7' AND operation_ulid NOT GLOB '*[^0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ]*')) NOT NULL REFERENCES context_retirement_preservations(operation_ulid) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 request_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(request_attempt)='integer' AND request_attempt>0),
 index_owner_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(index_owner_epoch)='integer' AND index_owner_epoch>0),
 PRIMARY KEY(operation_ulid,request_attempt), UNIQUE(operation_ulid,index_owner_epoch)
)
CREATE TRIGGER retirement_preservation_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON context_retirement_preservations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable preserving consent'); END

CREATE TRIGGER retirement_preservation_retained BEFORE DELETE ON context_retirement_preservations WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM context_retirement_records c WHERE c.operation_ulid=OLD.operation_ulid AND c.phase NOT IN ('complete','refused','abandoned')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'retained preserving consent'); END
CREATE TRIGGER retirement_preservation_claim_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON context_retirement_preservation_claims BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable preserving spend'); END

CREATE TRIGGER retirement_preservation_claim_retained BEFORE DELETE ON context_retirement_preservation_claims WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM context_retirement_records c WHERE c.operation_ulid=OLD.operation_ulid AND c.phase NOT IN ('complete','refused','abandoned')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'retained preserving spend'); END
